headers.X-GHL-Signature: Ed25519, current. Prefer this header when present.
headers.X-WH-Signature: RSA-SHA256, legacy. Announced for deprecation on 2026-09-01; its removal was not observed, so the relay refuses a request that carries only this one.

signed_bytes.note: The vendor's own sample verifies JSON.stringify(req.body), not the raw bytes. The relay accepts a signature over the raw bytes OR over the compact re-serialisation json.dumps(obj, separators=(',', ':')). A live delivery would settle which one is needed.

retries: any non-2xx is retried up to 12 times, excluding the original attempt, with exponential backoff and jitter
dedupe: the page says to store webhook ids to dedupe
envelope_note: The per event pages show a flat object with no webhookId and no data wrapper. The two disagree, so the relay reads either shape and uses a synthesised key when there is no webhookId (ASSUMED, confirm on a live delivery).
